title: PP_DEBUG overlay builds every per-frame label with default-allocator fmt.tprintf — unreclaimed heap growth while the overlay is on
evidence:
app/render/debug_overlay.odin:92  `label := fmt.tprintf("%d%%", p.util_pct)`; :110-111 `glob := fmt.tprintf("tick %d  gen %d  score %d  meter %d%%",
		stats.tick, stats.gen, stats.score, stats.meter)`; :114 `hash := fmt.tprintf("hash %016x", stats.sim_hash)`; :144-145 `row := fmt.tprintf("%-6s %4d %4d %4d %4d%% %5dms %s",
			name, c.demand, c.delivered, c.dropped, c.loss_pct, c.avg_latency_ms, sla)` (24 fmt.tprintf calls total in the file). The package convention (app/render/forecast.odin:81): `mult := fmt.aprintf("x%d", f.multiplier, allocator = context.temp_allocator)` — 14 explicit temp_allocator aprintf sites across the sibling render modules, and draw_text_c itself allocates `cbuf := make([dynamic]u8, 0, len(txt)+1, context.temp_allocator)` (view.odin:421). R2-W4's app/main.odin:225 `free_all(context.temp_allocator)` now runs once per frame, so temp-allocated strings are reclaimed.
detail: fmt.tprintf defaults to context.allocator (heap); the ~25 strings drawn per frame with the overlay on are never deleted — ~60KB/s unreclaimed growth in exactly the long congestion-watching sessions the overlay targets. Debug-gated, but violates the package's own per-frame-string discipline; R2-W4 was the same defect class.
recommended_fix: Switch the overlay's per-frame strings to the sibling convention: fmt.aprintf(..., allocator = context.temp_allocator) — the per-frame free_all already reclaims them (drops_line's repeated re-allocation concatenation included).
